text:
cheng: quick FYI — bringing Nimbus-v2 (q5) into canary for dedicated. Multilingual evals show a worrying drop for the legal zh+he locale tests, plus some bracket/bidi flipping reported by QA.

maria: ugh, any examples? can you paste a failing sample? :eyes:

cheng: here — input + expected vs q5 output (shortened):
```
INPUT: 我们同意第3条（סעיף 3）在本合同下的责任和义务。
EXPECTED: 我们同意第3条（סעיף 3）在本合同下的责任和义务。
Q5 OUTPUT: 我们同意第3条）סעיף 3（在本合同下的责任和义务。
```
Notice parentheses/bracket positions swapped and the embedded Hebrew phrase direction got messed up (visual order changed).

alex: metrics? how big a drop on the legal suite?

evalbot: quick summary: BLEU 6.2 -> 2.1, chrF 0.44 -> 0.29 on legal-zh-he testset, exact-bracket-preserve rate 98% -> 62%. Regression started with the q5 kernel rollout at 2026-03-18 03:14 UTC.

noah: could be kerning/mirroring op in the attention->kv cache quant path. we saw similar when we changed linear->fused matmul kernels last quarter. bisect suggestion: run qparams=... and kernel=old/new combos.

cheng: will run a small bisect. can someone confirm whether the Vocab/tokenization changed? tokenization diffs look minor (single-token merges), but this looks like post-tokenization reordering during decode.

alex: tokenization unlikely to flip brackets. suspect decode-time bidi handling or an inverted punctuation mirroring table that got quantized. check the mirroring LUT and its dtype cast during q5 conversion.

maria: quick mitigation — can we pin legal-zh-he route to fp16 model variant while we investigate? want to avoid customer-facing regressions. :+1:

simon: yes — can create routing rule to prefer fp16 for that locale and model family. I can push a canary policy for the dedicated pool.

deploy-bot: deploy request received for route update: pin route "model:nimbus-v2,locale:legal-zh-he" -> variant:fp16. ETA 8m. :robot_face:

noah: for repro, run: `python tools/repro.py --model nimbus-v2 --quant q5 --locale legal-zh-he --seed 42 --decode-sample 50` and capture raw token IDs + post-process mirroring table.

cheng: thanks — I'll run bisect + the repro and paste logs. if mirroring LUT cast is the culprit we can try re-quantizing that table to int8 with symmetric scale or keep it fp32.

maria: also add a tiny synthetic test that includes mixed CJK+RTL punctuation to the smoke suite so we catch this earlier.

cheng: ack — I created an eval PR (link in the thread) and started the bisect. will update with findings. :wave:
